motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Observed exit/deceleration easing for controls, disclosures, overlays, and route entrances.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Incumbent shared easing token; not a mandate to animate a new surface.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Mobile and auto-hidden navigation drawer movement.

motion.name: motion-feedback
motion.purpose: Shared immediate-control feedback.

motion.name: motion-popover
motion.purpose: Popover, select, tooltip, and toast transitions; zero in reduced motion.

motion.name: motion-dialog
motion.purpose: Incumbent fallback CSS dialog transform transition; zero in reduced motion. Shared Dialog clipped reveal uses its separate WAAPI durations below.

motion.name: motion-fade
motion.purpose: Overlay/disclosure fade; 80ms in reduced motion.

motion.name: motion-disclosure
motion.purpose: Bounded navigation tree expansion; zero in reduced motion.

motion.name: motion-chevron
motion.purpose: Incumbent disclosure timing token; zero in reduced motion.

motion.name: motion-travel
motion.purpose: Overlay/disclosure travel; zero in reduced motion.

motion.name: motion-scale
motion.purpose: Incumbent fallback CSS dialog starting/closing scale; one in reduced motion. Shared Dialog clipped reveal does not scale text.

motion.name: motion-popover-scale
motion.purpose: Popover starting scale; one in reduced motion.

motion.name: mobile-drawer
motion.purpose: Observed mobile sidebar transition, disabled for keyboard and reduced motion.

motion.name: route-entrance
motion.purpose: Existing keyed route entrance, with 8px starting travel and 25ms/45ms child delays. Recorded source behavior, not a new rule for page or live-data animation.

motion.name: chat-work-pulse
motion.purpose: Observed working dot opacity pulse; disabled by prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: single-choice-plate
motion.purpose: SlidingTabs selected indigo plate; selection updates immediately and only the plate changes geometry. Keyboard and OS/app reduced motion snap it; preference changes cancel in-flight movement.

motion.name: dialog-reveal-open
motion.purpose: Shared Dialog actual-size content reveal via clipped shell near its opener; command palettes and keyboard actions are immediate.

motion.name: dialog-reveal-close
motion.purpose: Shared guarded exit from the currently visible frame, including adopted render-prop footer controls; explicit navigation continuations run after exit. Dirty-close rejection restores the mounted dialog.

motion.name: dialog-reveal-shell
motion.value: min(56px, panel width, panel height); inset clip radius 14px
motion.purpose: Initial clipped shell reveals actual-size text rather than scaling the panel contents.

motion.name: dialog-reveal-travel-cap
motion.purpose: Bounds translation from distant opening controls; missing openers use the panel center.

motion.name: dialog-reduced-fade
motion.purpose: OS/app reduced-motion alternative: opacity only, no clipped expansion or travel; keyboard modality uses zero duration. Preference changes cancel in-flight spatial movement.

motion.name: featured-image-replacement
motion.purpose: Local featured-provider image replacement fade; disabled by OS/app reduced motion, not a general content-refresh animation rule.

components.description: Single bordered text-entry wrapper; this snippet previews anatomy, not provider execution.
components.html: Note · only saved here
components.css: .ds-compose{padding:18px 16px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong,#3e3e44);border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface,#191a1b);box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgb(0 0 0 / .08);transition:border-color 150ms ease,box-shadow 150ms ease;font-family:'Inter Variable',Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:var(--text,#f7f8f8)}.ds-compose:focus-within{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text,#f7f8f8) 32%,var(--border-strong,#3e3e44))}.ds-compose>textarea{display:block;resize:none;width:100%;min-height:78px;max-height:220px;padding:0 3px 16px;border:0;border-radius:0;outline:0;box-shadow:none;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:16px/1.6 'Inter Variable',Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif}.ds-compose>textarea::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#a1a6af)}.ds-compose-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.ds-compose-controls>span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#a1a6af)}.ds-compose-controls>button{min-height:36px;padding:7px 12px;border:1px solid var(--accent,#6266d5);border-radius:7px;background:var(--accent,#6266d5);color:var(--accent-text,#ffffff);font:550 13px/1.35 'Inter Variable',Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-compose-controls>button:hover{background:var(--accent-hover,#585dc4);border-color:var(--accent-hover,#585dc4)}.ds-compose-controls>button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#969aff);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:540px){.ds-compose{padding:12px 10px 8px}.ds-compose>textarea{min-height:44px;max-height:140px;padding-bottom:8px}}
